title: Acute Abdominal Pain Assessment
description: Davolash ishi bo'yicha O'tkir qorin og'rig'i anamnezi mavzusida klinik muloqot va tibbiy ingliz tili darsi.
scenario_prompt: You are a virtual patient presenting with symptoms related to Acute Abdominal Pain Assessment. Speak in natural, everyday patient English.

patient_profile.history: Patient presents with complaints of acute abdominal pain assessment.

grammar.title: First Conditional in Acute Abdomen Triage & Surgical Risk Warnings
grammar.title_uz: O'tkir Qorin Sindromida 1-Tur Shart Gaplari (First Conditional for Risk Triage)
grammar.title_ru: Первый Тип Условных Предложений (First Conditional) при Остром Животе
grammar.title_en: First Conditional in Acute Abdomen Triage & Surgical Risk Warnings
grammar.rule_explanation: Use First Conditional (If + Present Simple, will + Base Verb) to instruct patients and staff on red-flag surgical symptoms that require immediate emergency intervention.
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: O'tkir qorin og'rig'ida asoratlar xavfini tushuntirish va ogohlantirishda 'If + Present Simple, will + fe'l' tuzilmasidan foydalaniladi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: First Conditional (If + Present Simple, will + глагол) используется для инструктажа пациента о тревожных симптомах, требующих экстренной госпитализации.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: First conditional structures establish precise clinical contingency instructions for acute abdomen complications.
grammar.structure_pattern: If the pain + shifts / worsens + to [Location], you + will need + [Emergency surgery].
grammar.structure_pattern_uz: If + [Simptom Present Simple], Ega + will need + [Shoshilinch yordam].
grammar.structure_pattern_ru: If + [Симптом Present Simple], Подлежащее + will need + [Экстренная помощь].
grammar.structure_pattern_en: If the pain shifts/worsens, you will need emergency evaluation.

examples.sentence: If the abdominal tenderness shifts to the right lower quadrant, an immediate surgical consultation will be required.
examples.translation_uz: Agar qorindagi og'riqli sezuvchanlik o'ng pastki sohaga siljisa, zudlik bilan jarroh konsultatsiyasi talab qilinadi.
examples.translation_ru: Если болезненность сместится в правую подвздошную область, потребуется немедленная хирургическая консультация.

common_mistakes.incorrect: If the pain will become severe, go to hospital.
common_mistakes.correct: If the pain becomes severe, go to the hospital.
common_mistakes.explanation_ru: В придаточном предложении с 'if' вспомогательный глагол 'will' не употребляется.
common_mistakes.explanation_en: Do not put 'will' inside the if-clause.

vocabulary.example: The doctor assessed the patient for acute abdominal pain.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Tell me what happened before the abdominal pain became severe.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: I had eaten a large meal about two hours earlier, and I had gone to bed feeling slightly nauseated.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: What had you eaten?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: I had eaten fried meat, potatoes, and a rich dessert.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Had you experienced abdominal pain before you went to bed?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: I had already noticed a dull discomfort, but I thought it was indigestion.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: When did the pain become severe?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: It woke me at around midnight. The pain was much stronger than it had been earlier.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Where did it begin?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: It started in the upper abdomen and later moved towards the right side.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Had you vomited before the pain became severe?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: No, I hadn't. I felt nauseated, but I didn't vomit until later. Nurse: His temperature is 38.1°C, pulse 112, and he appears uncomfortable.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you had any previous abdominal surgery or known gallbladder problems?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: No previous surgery. I've never been diagnosed with gallstones.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Had you eaten anything unusual before the symptoms started?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: No, although the meal had been much heavier than usual.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Does the pain radiate to your back or shoulder?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: It seems to go through to my back at times.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: I'm going to examine your abdomen now. Tell me if the pain becomes significantly worse when I press or release.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: It's particularly tender in the upper right side.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: We need to consider several possibilities, including biliary disease, pancreatitis, peptic pathology and other causes of acute abdominal pain.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Could it be appendicitis?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: It is less typical given the location, but we cannot exclude diagnoses solely on the basis of one symptom. Nurse: I'll prepare blood samples for the requested tests and arrange the imaging pathway.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: We'll check inflammatory markers, liver enzymes, pancreatic enzymes, renal function and other relevant investigations.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Will I need surgery?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: That depends entirely on what we find. At this stage, it would be premature to say that an operation is necessary.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: What should I do while we're waiting?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Remain fasting until we have clarified whether a procedure may be required, and tell us immediately if the pain, vomiting, or weakness becomes significantly worse.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: All right. I understand.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. The examination and investigation results will help us narrow the differential diagnosis and decide on the safest treatment.

tests.question: What is the medical meaning of the term 'acute abdominal pain' in clinical consultation?
tests.explanation: 'acute abdominal pain' atamasining to'g'ri ma'nosi: o'tkir qorin og'rig'i.

tests.question: Which term corresponds to 'biroz ko'ngli aynigan'?
tests.explanation: 'biroz ko'ngli aynigan' ma'nosiga mos keluvchi tibbiy termin 'slightly nauseated' hisoblanadi.

tests.question: Which of the following is the grammatically and clinically standard question to ask about the duration of symptoms?
tests.option_a: How long do you having this symptom?
tests.option_b: How long has this condition been bothering you?
tests.option_c: Since what time you have this problem?
tests.option_d: How many days you are feeling pain?
tests.explanation: Klinik anamnezda davomiylikni so'rash uchun Present Perfect Continuous ('How long has... been bothering you?') to'g'ri shakl hisoblanadi.

tests.question: When evaluating acute pain, what is the best phrasing to assess pain character?
tests.option_a: Is your pain bad or very bad?
tests.option_b: Can you describe the pain—is it sharp, dull, throbbing, or aching?
tests.option_c: Why do you have sharp pain today?
tests.explanation: Og'riq xarakterini aniqlashda shifokor ochiq va taklif qiluvchi variantlar (sharp, dull, throbbing, aching) beradi.
